connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Quotations, orders and invoices made on the phone are the same documents as in the office.
Payment runs, cash and VAT come straight from the books.
Customers, leads and the deal board travel with you.
Meetings recorded on the phone come back as minutes and drafts.
Expense receipts photographed on the phone become drafts to check.
Calendar, rooms and Meet are on the phone too.

faq.q: Does the phone work out prices itself?
faq.a: No. Every price and status comes from the same rules the office uses, so the phone and the computer always agree.

faq.q: What happens when I lose signal?
faq.a: Comments, follows and invitation answers wait and send when you are back. Approvals and anything that moves money need a connection.

faq.q: Can I decline a request from the phone?
faq.a: Yes. Declining always asks you for a reason, so nobody is left guessing why.
